about: Automatic per-device defaults for VesperTV (lib/services/device_defaults.dart). A matching rule turns a setting on by default; the user's own choice always wins. match: every field must equal (case-insensitive) manufacturer / model / hardware / socModel / sdk. set: compatVideo, hideVideoOnSports. Same id as a bundled rule replaces it; an empty set turns it off.

rules.note: Fire TV Cube (3rd gen): live picture stayed on top of other pages (2026-10-23)
